contract.decision: Measure speed and peak/retained array memory for the corrected baseline versus workspace sampler optimizations.
contract.arithmetic: NumPy float64; identical generated inputs and fixed NumPy Generator seeds per case.

scope.name: strong_signal
scope.description: Five strong signals in an independent design; online Rao-Blackwell summaries.

scope.name: weak_signal
scope.description: Weak signals with a lighter sparsity penalty; plain online sampling.

scope.name: correlated_competitors
scope.description: Five signal groups have four strongly correlated competing predictors (rho=0.95); no claim of verified multimodality.

scope.name: trace_heavy
scope.description: Stored gamma, beta, sigma2, and Rao-Blackwell traces; equal retained and burn-in lengths expose retained backing allocations.

contract.thread_limit_kind: cooperative environment variables plus threadpoolctl runtime limits
contract.comparison: Same inputs, RNG seed, interpreter and thread limits; baseline/optimized order alternates between cases. Separate fresh worker processes for speed and memory. Speed repeats use identical deterministic chains to measure runtime variability, not Monte Carlo uncertainty.
contract.speed_timer: DF_MCMC call only; includes Gram construction and sampling, excludes data generation/imports/digest computation. No tracemalloc during speed timings.
contract.memory_definition: tracemalloc starts after input generation; output_backing_array_bytes deduplicates ultimate ndarray backing allocations, including burn-in slices. Windows peak RSS is lifetime peak working set and includes interpreter/import/input memory.
contract.result_check: Exact result hashes and input hashes are reported. Floating-point hash mismatch requires investigation and does not by itself prove numerical inequivalence.
contract.exclusions: No claim about all dimensions, machines, data, posterior mixing, or verified multimodality. No fresh accuracy theorem is inferred from timings.
contract.failure_interpretation: Timeout or worker error is incomplete performance evidence, never a speed or correctness win. Source changes invalidate comparability.
